A 3 by 3 magic square uses the integers 1 to 9.
Complete the following statements to show that the line total is 15.
The total of the integers 1 to 9
= .............................
The total of the integers in all three rows
= .............................
The line total
= ............................ ' ............................ =   15
[2]

mark_scheme.text:
The total of the integers from 1 to 9
= 45
The total of the integers in all three rows
= 45
The line total
45 ÷ 3
= 15
